FROM dim_date
WHERE calendar_date >= '2025-01-01' AND calendar_date <= '2026-12-31'
ORDER BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period

calls.statement:
SELECT 
    ds.store_id,
    ds.store_name,
    SUM(rds.net_sales) AS net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales rds
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON rds.store_id = ds.store_id
WHERE rds.business_date >= '2025-08-25' 
  AND rds.business_date <= '2025-09-21'
  AND ds.is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY ds.store_id, ds.store_name
ORDER BY net_sales DESC

calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT business_date) AS days_in_period, COUNT(*) AS rows
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date >= '2025-08-25' AND business_date <= '2025-09-21'

-- Final query for store league table - period 5 FY2025/26
SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(rds.net_sales) DESC) AS rank,
    ds.store_id,
    ds.store_name,
    ds.region,
    ds.format,
    SUM(rds.net_sales) AS net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales rds
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON rds.store_id = ds.store_id
WHERE rds.business_date >= '2025-08-25' 
  AND rds.business_date <= '2025-09-21'
  AND ds.is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY ds.store_id, ds.store_name, ds.region, ds.format
HAVING SUM(rds.net_sales) > 0
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
